Cash flow doesn't take care of itself. Finance teams spend too much time on repetitive tasks - chasing invoices, matching payments, building spreadsheets. We're building AI agents that handle the operational work, so finance leaders can focus on decisions that move the business forward. We're not just automating finance. We're preserving the conditions for innovation itself.

Tesorio was founded in 2015 by Carlos Vega and Fabio Fleitas after seeing firsthand how finance teams at fast-growing companies were drowning in manual AR processes. Collections happened in spreadsheets. Cash application was a guessing game. Forecasting was based on gut feel.

After graduating from Y Combinator in 2015, we started by automating collections workflows, then expanded into cash application, forecasting, and payment management. Today, Tesorio is a Connected Financial Operations platform that turns revenue into cash - faster and more predictably than any manual process.
Leading enterprise finance teams trust Tesorio, and our customers have collectively reduced DSO by an average of 30% while dramatically accelerating cash conversion.
